sn45.149:1.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave ye keci balakaraṇīyā kammantā kayiranti sabbe te paṭhaviṃ nissāya paṭhaviyaṃ patiṭṭhāya evamete balakaraṇīyā kammantā kayiranati.
